title: Artificial Sputum Medium
protocol: Take 800 ml of distilled water in a beaker and place it on a magnetic stirring plate.
Use a magnetic stirrer to dissolve the ingredients completely.
Add mucin to the mixture with constant stirring.
Add DNA to the mixture with constant stirring.
Add DTPA to the mixture with constant stirring.
Add salts NaCl and KCl one after another with constant stirring.
Add Tris base to the mixture with constant stirring.
Add 250 mg of each amino acid except tryptophan with constant stirring.
Stir the mixture continuously to dissolve amino acids.
Insert a calibrated pH probe into the medium.
Check the pH of the medium continuously with constant stirring.
Adjust the pH using Tris base until it stabilizes at 7.0.
Make up the volume of the medium to 1000 ml.
Sterilize the medium in an autoclave at 110°C for 15 minutes.
Cool the sterilized medium and maintain sterile conditions.
Add filter-sterilized tryptophan (250 mg/L of medium) from the stock while maintaining sterility.
Add 5 ml of egg yolk emulsion to the cooled, sterilized medium while maintaining sterility.
Mix the medium well after adding tryptophan and egg yolk emulsion.
Store the mixed medium in a refrigerator for several months.
